title.narrative: Enhancing Indonesia's access to international climate finance and private investments (Readiness 3)

description.narrative: Active

Based on readiness needs assessment, a multiple-year readiness proposal is planned to be proposed that focuses on strategic support to further strengthen Indonesia’s pipeline and project development into high-quality bankable proposals particularly from Direct Access Entities and the implementation of Indonesia's national climate finance strategy. The program strategy will consist of four main objectives: 1) Capacity building for climate finance coordination, 2) Strategic frameworks for low-emission investment, 3) Paradigm-shifting pipeline development, and 4) Knowledge sharing and learning.
